firstAttempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: desktop visual-direction PAINT-OVER of the existing original AZMARA strategy town, a proposal only, not final game assets.
Input image 1: edit target and sole visual reference: ORIGINAL AZMARA screenshot, not another game.
Keep exactly the same desktop framing, central Town Hall anchor, existing other building/empty-site positions, fixed transport sites and central lower wall-site/gate anchor. Keep all existing building artwork and silhouettes recognizable at their current positions and roughly their current sizes. Do not add owned buildings, remove building sites, relocate buildings, redesign UI, add text or simulate new functions.
Paint primarily the GROUND and environmental integration. Use one coherent high oblique orthographic/dimetric view matching the illustrated buildings: ground diagonals about +/-30deg, camera elevation approximately35deg, verticals remain vertical, NO vanishing point, NO narrowing into photographic distance. Warm light from upper-left, attached soft shadows toward lower-right. Existing upper mountain band must become restrained painterly game relief seen from that SAME camera, no photo-like horizon/canyon; mountains only at rear, do not enlarge margins.
Goal: buildings feel embedded in a believable original desert town rather than pasted on sand. Real surfaces: hard-packed earth courts, irregular sandstone paving, shallow kerbs, worn street edges, clear doorstep links, shaded pocket spaces, connected small public courts. Streets visibly have width and surface, not bright outlined tubes, thick ribbons or floating geometry. The road/garden treatment must leave the complete building silhouettes and empty sites unobscured. Rich but readable micro-detail, fine grain not noisy rocks.
Preserve AZMARA warm buff/ochre sandstone, dark timber, restrained existing teal awnings and clay-red accents; vegetation in localized muted date-palm/olive greens, NOT continuous grass. No other game's art, layout, colours, UI, text or images. No coastal water, river, lake, sea, boats or ships, modern infrastructure, sacred figures/text, gods, logos or watermark. The screenshot's existing UI is not part of this redesign: leave it unchanged as far as possible. Landscape1440x900 composition, no illustration border or title.
DIRECTION A — OASIS TOWN, LEVEL 1 REAL START: only the central wooden Town Hall shack is built; preserve all22 EMPTY sites and their positions, including unbuilt wall. Do NOT build a perimeter wall or complete other buildings. Replace the green-rimmed diamond board tokens with softly worn earth clearings, a few short timber survey stakes or rolled shade-cloth bundles, not lush gardens or paving at every site. A modest shallow closed oasis pool and 3–5 date palms in one available pocket, one weathered shade sail, a narrow worn dusty footpath towards the Hall, pots and a few small seated/walking silhouettes. Large open sand areas are intentional but subtly compacted around occupied space, not flat blank. Very sparse life and poor timber material, distinctly an emerging settlement. NO grand boulevard, fountains, formal marble, green park or luxury. All22 reserves remain visibly free and selectable in principle.

DIRECTION A — OASIS TOWN, LEVEL 50 IDEAL OCCUPANCY: all existing23 sites already occupied, preserve their placement and actual AZMARA building identities. Make town ground visibly cultivated and organized. Connect narrow cream-buff sandstone streets with irregular pavers and dimensional shallow kerbs to real doorways; lay integrated courtyards/earth workshops/market forecourts instead of isolated square bases. Local shaded date-palm groves, pocket gardens and pergolas occupy safe gaps. Two small enclosed blue-green fountain basins with thin closed garden water RILLS (no continuous river or navigable water) link only a small garden pocket. Restrained market textiles/crates and tiny pedestrians suggest trade; small groups of merchants and a pack animal in a transport yard, never block a building. Maintain desert soil and dry exterior, rather than forest or grass everywhere. The existing open-rear side/front wall is only context: paint it to same parallel projection/light/ground scale, no perspective shrink, keep central gate and do not emphasize/expand perimeter. No extra towers or copied repeated gate modules; do not replan wall route. The town interior—not massive wall or scenery—is the focus.

More trade character than oasis: stalls without permanent additional buildings, baskets, bales, earthen jars, tiny merchants, one small pack-caravan silhouette group at a transport yard. correctiveAttempt.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: second and final attempt on an ORIGINAL AZMARA Oasis Town level50 desktop paint-over PROPOSAL. Input Image1 is the edit target: our own earlier paint-over. No other game's images or style are provided or allowed.
Primary request: correct the environmental-ground integration only. Keep all town buildings, their silhouettes, sizes, positions, central Hall, existing front/side wall and central gate, all UI panels, bottom toolbar, and full canvas framing unchanged. Do not replan wall/towers or relocate sites. Keep exact same town and existing original architecture.
Replace the photographic-looking receding far canyon/horizon band with softly painted sandstone ridge forms seen from the SAME elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC/dimetric camera as buildings. No sky, no photographic atmospheric valley with disappearing vanishing point; land features do not shrink steeply in distance. Mountains only behind the town. Make the outside foreground calmer fine-grained desert, with fewer exterior palms/rock props so attention stays INSIDE.
Inside the existing town, in available gaps ONLY, show one distinctive coherent oasis-garden pocket: short very narrow blue-green enclosed ornamental WATER RILLS set in shallow stone channels with visible small kerbs, linking the two existing fountain basins across one or two garden/court strips. Water channels terminate in these small basins and stay entirely in the garden; NO river, stream, waterway through town, sea, boats, navigable water, waterfall or irrigation infrastructure. Keep all building foundations, doors, transport yards and main walking streets clear. A few restrained pergola shade patches and dark date-palm/shrub groups around these rills, desert everywhere else.
Preserve the rich illustrated 2.5D hand-painted-game treatment; warm upper-left sunlight, consistent short soft lower-right shadows, buff sandstone street floors, terracotta/timber architecture and existing limited teal cloth. Existing buildings and UI must not be redrawn or relocated. No added owned buildings, site count change, religious material, logos, watermark or text. This is not a shipped scene or final wall artwork. One shared spatial camera, detailed playable town, not a picturesque travel painting.
